en: Morning, Grandpa.
Something the matter, Grandpa?
I have a tutorial in this paper that has my friend Matt Baker a real upset.
cn: 这份报纸的社论让我朋友纳特·贝克很不安。

en: Ah, I'll read it to you.
The old library building on Chestnut Street,
which has been vacant for over a year now,
is supposed to be made into a community center
cn: 本应被改建成社区中心，

en: to serve the senior citizens as well as the younger people of Riverdale.
Due to lack of funds for the repainting of the interior of the building,
cn: 用于建筑内部的重新粉刷

en: and for the furniture needed,
the plans for the community center have been postponed indefinitely.
Who's coming over to talk about it?
That serious a problem, Grandpa?
It is.
See, Matt's not as lucky as I am, Robbie. He doesn't have any family with him.
He lives alone, and depends on places like a community center to be with people,
cn: 依赖像社区中心这样的地方

en: people his own age.
cn: 与人在一起——和他同龄的人。

en: But there's the whole community center on Elm Street?
cn: 但榆树街有老社区中心。

en: It's small, and the problem is it's set up primarily for kids to play.
cn: 问题是它主要是为孩子们玩耍设的。

en: Ping pong tables, soda machines, and lots of music.
cn: 乒乓球桌、汽水机，还有大量音乐。

en: It's too noisy for some older people like Matt.
cn: 对像纳特这样的老人来说太吵了。

en: I never realized that.
It's hard for some older people to take all that noise.
cn: 有些老人很难承受那些噪音。

en: That's why the new community center is a good idea.
cn: 所以新社区中心是个好主意。

en: Part of the building for older people, part of the building for younger people.
I see what you mean.
Well, that must be Matt.
It could be Alexandra. She's coming over this morning to help me with my Matt.
cn: 她今早过来帮我学数学。

en: Tony, something cold to drink?
I'd love some cola, please.
Cola, coming up.
I really appreciate you coming over to help me with my Matt.
cn: 真的很感谢你过来帮我学数学。

en: My final exam is next Tuesday.
You're so good in all your other subjects.
I just can't understand why you have so many problems with Matt.
cn: 你为什么数学有这么多问题。

en: Hi, Alexandra.
Hi, Mr. Stewart.
I thought that was Matt Baker who rang the front door bell.
cn: 我以为是纳特·贝克按了门铃。

en: Don't let me interrupt you.
No problem, Grandpa.
We're just having some cola before getting to the tough stuff.
cn: 然后开始难的部分——数学。

en: Matt.
You'll do anything to avoid getting down to math lessons, Mr. Stewart.
cn: 他什么借口都用得上，就是不愿意开始学数学，

en: I was the same way.
Really, Grandpa?
Really.
I didn't like math.
I wasn't good at it, and I didn't like studying it.
But you had to be good at math.
You graduated from engineering school.
cn: 你可是工程学院毕业的。

en: I was, but not in high school.
For some reason, I couldn't get a handle on it.
cn: 不知什么原因，我抓不到窍门。

en: Then in college.
cn: 后来大学时，我变得擅长了。

en: I became good at it.
Then there's hope for Robbie.
I can't wait.
Do you think I can just skip it now and get to it at college?
cn: 你觉得我现在能跳过它，等大学再学吗？

en: You'll never get to college to find out, Robbie, if you skip it now.
cn: 你永远到不了大学去验证，罗比，

en: That must be it.
I'd like you to meet my friend Matt Baker.
cn: 我想让你见见我的朋友纳特·贝克。

en: This is Alexandra Pappas, and this is my friend, son Robbie,
cn: 这是亚历山德拉·帕帕斯，这是我孙子罗比，

en: whom I think you've met once or twice before.
Nice to meet you, Mr. Baker.
cn: 很高兴认识你，贝克先生。

en: Hi, Mr. Baker.
We met before.
Where?
In town.
At the hardware store.
I remember now.
Right.
Hi.
Hello, Alexandra.
But don't let us keep you from your math tutoring, Robbie.
cn: 别让我们耽误你学数学，罗比。

en: I know you want to get to it.
Stay, stay.
I told you, he'll use any excuse to avoid math.
cn: 我说了吧。他用任何借口逃避数学。

en: Did you read the story in the paper, Malcolm?
cn: 你看了报纸上的报道了吗，马尔科姆？

en: I did.
It's a serious matter for the father.
cn: 对我们很多人来说是件严肃的事。

en: It's a serious matter.
It is.
Come on out to the patio.
We'll talk about it out there.
Thanks.
It's nice to meet you again.
Come on.
You'll hear about it.
There is a way, Matt.
Get our friends to roll their sleeves up and get to work.
cn: 我们让朋友们卷起袖子开始干活。

en: It's certainly a good idea.
If I could take a look at the place,
I could probably tell what it requires to fix it up.
cn: 我大概能说出翻修需要什么。

en: How much paint?
How many hours of work?
That's what I came to ask you to do, Malcolm.
cn: 这正是我来请你做的，马尔科姆。

en: If you would supervise the refurbishing,
I'll find the people to help do it.
I'll help too, Mr. Baker.
I can get some of my friends to go around the neighborhood
cn: 我能叫一些朋友在邻里间走访，

en: and collect the furniture we need.
I'll help.
We'll meet tomorrow morning right here.
cn: 明天。是的。我们明早在这里碰面。

en: Can we help?
I'd really like to.
Sure.
We might need you to come through with your friends, Robbie.
cn: 我们可能需要你和朋友帮忙，罗比。

en: Not just to go around the neighborhood asking for furniture,
cn: 不仅在邻里间收集家具，

en: but to help with the paint job work,
and maybe too much for us.
cn: 那是累人的活，对我们可能太难。

en: I'll do it.
I'll talk to them.
cn: 我们以后有机会和他们谈。

en: And tomorrow morning, we'll all meet here to discuss the plan.
cn: 明早我们都来这里讨论计划？

en: Tomorrow morning it is.
I'd like you to meet my friend, Malcolm Stewart.
cn: 我想让你见见我的朋友马尔科姆·斯图尔特。

en: Malcolm, this is Joanne Thompson.
cn: 马尔科姆，这是乔安妮·汤普森。

en: Hello, Joanne.
Nice to meet you.
cn: 你好，乔安妮。很高兴认识你。

en: My pleasure, Malcolm.
And this is Abe Lucas.
cn: 这是乔安妮·汤普森——还有阿贝·卢卡斯，

en: You must remember Abe.
cn: 这是阿贝·卢卡斯。你一定记得阿贝。

en: He ran the drugstore and used to play drums
with the jazz band on weekends.
cn: 周末常和爵士乐队打鼓。

en: Sure I do.
Hi, Abe.
Hello, Mrs. Stewart.
Malcolm, please.
Hello, Malcolm.
Sit down.
Sit down.
Have some coffee.
And I've got some delicious Danish pastry for you.
cn: 我给你们准备了美味的丹麦酥。

en: Where's your grandson Robbie and his friend Alexandra?
cn: 你孙子罗比和他朋友亚历山德拉呢？

en: Weren't they going to be here this morning?
I thought so too.
I'm surprised they're not here.
Bobby left early this morning to meet Alexandra.
cn: 罗比今早很早就去见亚历山德拉了。

en: Frankly, I thought they'd be here.
cn: 坦白说，我以为他们会来，但是……

en: But it's okay.
I'm sure they met well, but they probably had other things on their minds.
cn: 但他们可能心里有其他事。

en: I understand you used to be in the construction business, Malcolm.
I was indeed.
I wonder if you would take a look at the old library
cn: 我不知道你能不能去看看旧图书馆，

en: and make sure that it is in good condition
so that we don't have to worry about any structural problems.
cn: 这样我们就不用担心结构问题。

en: Well, when can I do that?
cn: 我什么时候能去？我很乐意。

en: I'd be happy to.
We've got a mission to go inside the old building during the week.
Tuesday or Wednesday?
That's fine with me.
I can do it either day.
That would be very helpful.
I think the building just needs a good cleaning.
And a good paint job.
Then we have to furnish it.
I wish Robbie and Alexandra had come to this meeting.
cn: 真希望罗比和亚历山德拉来参加这次会议。

en: They had some ideas about getting the place fixed up.
cn: 他们对翻修那地方有些想法。

en: Perhaps they'll show up.
cn: 也许他们会出现的。同时，

en: In the meantime, let me give you some additional thoughts and ideas I have.
cn: 让我给你们一些我额外的想法和主意。

en: Okay.
Go ahead, Joanne.
As I said, mostly the building just needs a good cleaning.
cn: 如我所说，建筑主要需要好好清洁。

en: This place can be developed with one real intergenerational program.
cn: 成一个真正的代际项目。

en: That's an idea I like.
A community center with the kinds of programs that fit everything.
And programs that don't leave anyone out.
cn: 不让任何人被排除在外的项目。

en: It's asking a lot.
But we can't do it without talking to the young people,
cn: 但不和年轻人谈，我们做不到。

en: finding out what they want.
If only Robbie and Alexandra were here.
cn: 要是罗比和亚历山德拉在这里就好了。

en: Don't be upset now.
We'll have a chance to talk to them later.
cn: 我们将有一个chance去谈话去them待会

en: It's not like Robbie.
If he says he's going to be here, he's here.
cn: 如果他说会来，他就会来。

en: I wonder what's the problem.
Joanne, sorry I'm late.
cn: 嗨，大家。对不起我迟到了。

en: Alexandra and I have been busy at work this morning on the community center project.
And we brought someone along who can help.
cn: 我们带了个能帮忙的人来。

en: You remember Charles Maxwell, grandpa?
cn: 你记得查尔斯·麦克斯韦吧，爷爷？

en: He's the editor of the Riverdale paper.
cn: 他是里弗代尔报纸的编辑。

en: He wrote some nice articles on Mom when she was running for the school board.
cn: 他写过一些不错的文章。

en: Yes, I remember. You were a great help.
cn: 是的，我记得。你帮了大忙。

en: Hi, Mr. Stewart. I hope to be a bigger help on the new community center project.
cn: 希望在新社区中心项目上能帮更大的忙。

en: From what Robbie and Alexandra have told me,
cn: 从罗比和亚历山德拉告诉我的看，

en: you people are making one big story.
cn: 你们这些人正在制造一个大新闻。

en: Let me introduce you, Mr. Maxwell.
cn: 让我给你介绍一下，麦克斯韦先生。

en: This is Matt Baker, who is responsible for this meeting.
And this is Joanne Thompson and Abe Lucas, who used to run the drugstore in town.
cn: 他以前在镇上经营药店。

en: Robbie and Alexandra told me what you need to fix up the old library.
cn: 你们翻修旧图书馆需要什么。

en: I am planning to write an editorial that I think will help you.
cn: 我打算写一篇社论，我觉得能帮上忙。

en: Let's go. What are your questions?
cn: 开始吧。你们有什么问题？

en: Okay, now I have first a couple of questions.
cn: 好。现在，我有……首先……几个问题。

en: Have you talked to the community council?
cn: 你们和社区委员会谈过吗？

en: And have you had an engineer come in to do an inspection?
cn: 你们请工程师来检查过吗？

en: Okay, what do you need most of all?
People power.
Men and women, young and old, to give us their time.
To do what?
To help scrub the building interior clean.
cn: 帮忙把建筑内部刷洗干净。

en: So that we can repaint it.
And you also need bodies to do repainting.
cn: 你们也需要人来重新粉刷？

en: That's right.
And we'll also need some ladders and some brushes and some paint.
When do you need the volunteers and where do they report?
cn: 你们什么时候需要志愿者，

en: I've got the council to agree to open the building for us on the next four weekends.
cn: 下四个周末向我们开放建筑。

en: How about furnishings?
Are there any special requirements that I should list in the paper?
cn: 有什么特殊要求我应该列在报纸上吗？

en: Yes.
Here is a copy of all the things we need to start with.
cn: 这是我们需要开始的所有物品清单。

en: Four desks, eight straight back chairs,
cn: 八张直背椅。三十张折叠椅。

en: 30 folding chairs, six table lamps, three end tables, one piano.
cn: 六盏台灯。三张茶几。一架钢琴。

en: This is a good start.
These items shouldn't be difficult to come by once I print the article in the paper.
cn: 这些物品应该不难弄到，

en: This community has always been very generous.
I agree, Mr. Maxwell.
What you're saying is in order for the center to succeed,
cn: 你的意思是，为了让这个中心成功，

en: we need to put together volunteers from the various generations of future users.
cn: 从未来用户的各代人中。

en: That's right.
And without their energy and stamina, there's no way we can complete this project.
cn: 我们无法完成这个项目。

en: Got it.
Now give me some information about how you see the building being used.
cn: 关于你们打算怎么使用建筑。

en: Here, on the ground floor, we have the reception area.
It's here, Robbie.
Charles Maxwell lived up to his word.
cn: 查尔斯·麦克斯韦说到做到。

en: At the Stewart family home on Linden Street yesterday,
a group of caring Riverdale citizens gathered to plan the refurbishing of the old library
cn: 一群热心的里弗代尔市民聚集在一起，

en: to transform it into a new community center.
cn: 将其改造成新的社区中心。

en: The original plan by the council was tabled because of lack of funds.
The new plan needs you.
You can call it a community unity plan.
cn: 你可以称之为社区团结计划。

en: It needs your time, and it needs your energy,
cn: 它需要你的时间，需要你的精力。

en: and it needs your contributions of furniture, paint, brushes, ladders, lamps.
A list of these items and the volunteer form can be picked up at the Riverdale Press offices.
cn: 可在里弗代尔报社办公室领取。

en: By working together, this community can do anything to benefit its citizens.
cn: 这个社区能为市民做任何事，

en: And we know you will all work together towards refurbishing the old library
cn: 我们相信大家都会一起努力，

en: and making it a new community center.
cn: 把它变成新的社区中心。

en: Charles Maxwell, editor.
